fact_text: On 28 Nov 2024 the KSE-100 touched 100,000 for the third or fourth time, while still trading in the 99,000 zone.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst's view was that the index stays in profit-taking territory until it closes above 100,000, and that gains are best booked in parts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: A State Bank of Pakistan regulation requires Islamic banks to pass 75% of the earnings from their pool to depositors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: Net interest margins in Nov 2024 were about 8% at Meezan, about 6% at a newer Islamic bank, and about 3% at conventional banks, showing why Islamic banks paid depositors less.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst expects the depositor-sharing rule to narrow Islamic banks' margins, because higher returns to depositors cut into the spread that gave them their earnings edge.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan removed a cap on the minimum profit rate, a change the analyst said will lower returns for corporate and government depositors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: Islamic banks are withdrawing service charges on deposits of 5 billion or more from corporate clients, as the analyst described it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst said state-owned banks such as National Bank and Bank of Punjab face a larger impact from the minimum profit-rate change, because they hold large corporate and government deposits.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst said tariff adjustments already in the Sui Northern Gas accounts should lift future earnings when the company reports them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst said tariff adjustments in the Sui Southern Gas accounts should lift future earnings when the company reports them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst said K-Electric's multi-year tariff decision for transmission and distribution is still awaited and is a factor to watch.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)

fact_text: A share sale involving stakes held in OGDC and PPL would hit PPL's per-share earnings more than OGDC's, according to the analyst, and its timing is uncertain.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Finally KSE 100 Index Crosses 100,000 Points |  Banking Sector MEBL & FABL  | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-28)
